name: gacha
note: Gacha / casino love (Tony, sprint 0930). LAST in the play order. Every scored pick rolls once, seeded (gacha.js): a ♥ pick (love > 0) may crit (+10 at 7%, else +5 at 15%); a 💔 pick (love < 0) may be punished (-5 rage at 12%, else -2 anger at 25%). Pity = 'redeem your fault': after 2 💔 picks in a row the next ♥ pick is a guaranteed love-bomb (+10). The goal walk ignores bonuses (base love only), so 100% stays reachable without luck; bonuses clamp at 0..goal. Skip (Esc) scores base love, no rolls. Debug: ?seed=N replays a seed, ?gacha=<tier id> forces that tier on every pick of its sign. FX + face layers: src/date-beta/art/emotion/. Schema: research/sprint-0930/emotion-fx/SCHEMA.md.
